limitations: Modelled estimate, not a count; use the low-high range, not only the central value.
The connection growth rate (2022-2025) is assumed to hold since 2011.
Household size is held at its 2011 value; falling household size would mean more households than shown.
One HMWSSB connection can serve many flats, so connection growth may understate household growth in apartment areas.
method: central = Census 2011 x exp(14 x (ward building log growth + city shift)), shift set so the city grows at the HMWSSB domestic-connection rate; GHS-POP in range only

sources.buildings: Open Buildings Temporal via E3 (year shocks removed)
sources.census: Census 2011 via E2 (2009 to 2016 ward crosswalk)
sources.connections: HMWSSB billing and collection data (Telangana portal, GODL)
sources.ghs_pop: GHS-POP R2023A 3 arc-second, EU JRC, CC BY 4.0
